title: CRLR/89/2010 of SMT. GANGA DEVI AND ORS Vs SRI PAN SINGH

paras.text:
CRLR No. 89 of 2010
With
CRLR No. 127 of 2010
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Rajesh Joshi, Advocate for the revisionists.
Mr. L.K. Tewari, Advocate holding brief of
Mr. Dinesh Gahatori, Advocate for the respondent.
Parties, present in person were directed to
remain present before Mediation Center of this Court
to explore possibility to settle the dispute amicably.
Learned Mediator has submitted his report that
parties have settled their dispute amicably.
Learned Counsel for the parties and parties
present before this Court in person have stated let
present revision be disposed of in terms of report of
learned Mediator.
Order accordingly.
(Alok Singh, J.)
 02.11.2015
Deepak
